The indexed full-install binding matches all 15 frozen solution files. Independent hash verification found all 77 indexed artifacts current. Scripted browser evidence reports 25 runtime, 12 history, 4 post-restart, 8 gate/polish, 2 focused regression and 3 canvas/form cases passing; see per-row-review/evidence/17/coverage-check.json and coverage-map.md.
